proposals.evidence: The full compound consists of the western/northwestern *calyati walking family plus gone (gata). Turner specifically attests Marwari/Gujarati cāl- and Punjabi call-; the source’s c/ts and vowel spellings are retained. The second member is the gay-/geh- perfect auxiliary.
